introHtml: Bulwark dress shirts combine flame-resistant protection with a professional appearance, making them a top choice for safety managers and HR directors who need branded uniforms that meet NFPA 70E standards. Unlike standard dress shirts, these FR-rated garments offer peace of mind in hazardous environments without sacrificing a polished look. Customize with your company logo via embroidery or screen printing for a cohesive, safety-first image.
